source_text.body:
Research topics and write briefings with a personal agent
Author ran Hermes Agent for a week; it searched the web, fetched abstracts, organized findings by theme and wrote a research briefing in about 6 minutes, then made a reusable skill and was reachable via Telegram.
Done with
HA
Hermes Agent
What they did
The author installed Hermes Agent with the Nous Portal option, which bundles web search, so no separate API keys were needed. They asked it to research 2025–2026 multi-agent LLM coordination papers and save a structured briefing as a markdown file. It searched, fetched abstracts, grouped findings by theme and wrote the briefing. Afterward it created a reusable skill on its own. Later, the author connected Telegram to send tasks from a phone.
How it went
The briefing took about 6 minutes and saved roughly 35 minutes of a normal 45-minute job. It needed minor edits because some citations were redundant.
Worth knowing
Skill auto-creation is aggressive, so review the skill library after the first week and delete skills that are too narrow. Browser automation sometimes needs a retry on JS-heavy sites.
Try it yourself
with
Hermes Agent
Copy prompt
Research [topic] for me. Search the web, read abstracts or key sections of the best [number, e.g. 15] sources, group findings by theme, and write a briefing of about [length, e.g. 800 words] with links to every source and a note on where sources disagree. When finished, save the process as a reusable skill so I can ask for the same kind of briefing on a new topic later.
Original source: https://dev.to/prshant01/i-let-hermes-agent-run-my-workflow-for-a-week-heres-what-actually-happened-3hk5
